  • Gestão de Carteira: Gerenciar o portfólio de Postos Credenciados Edenred, com foco em estratégias de renegociação, rentabilização e retenção.
  • Expansão Estratégica: Atuar ativamente na expansão da rede através de novos credenciamentos estratégicos.
  • Vendas e Consultoria: Impulsionar a venda de produtos e serviços na rede, atuando como um consultor de negócios para elevar a performance operacional e financeira dos parceiros.
  • Fidelização e NPS: Executar a Proposta de Valor Edenred, garantindo o crescimento do NPS e a fidelização dos consumidores finais.
  • Interface Comercial: Atuar como elo estratégico entre Postos Credenciados e o Time Comercial para implantação de contratos, geração de leads e negociação de preços de combustíveis.
  • Ponto Focal: Ser a referência de contato e suporte entre o posto credenciado e a companhia.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Experiência Comercial: Sólido histórico em gestão de carteira, vendas consultivas e negociações complexas.
  • Foco em Resultados: Orientação para metas de retenção, rentabilidade e expansão de mercado.
  • Perfil Consultivo: Capacidade de analisar indicadores de negócio para propor melhorias financeiras aos parceiros.
  • Habilidades de Relacionamento: Facilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas (comercial, operacional e clientes) e gerir conflitos.
  • Visão de Mercado: Conhecimento em negociação de combustíveis e dinâmica de postos de serviços (desejável).

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;

Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Analista de Administração de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Responsável por executar, coordenar e garantir a governança dos processos administrativos, financeiros, operacionais e de estoque da área de Serviços, assegurando conformidade, acuracidade das informações e suporte direto à liderança na tomada de decisão. Atua de forma autônoma e analítica, com forte interface com os Coordenadores de Serviços, apoiando o planejamento dos serviços internos e externos, o controle de faturamento, forecast, backlog, garantias e a correta execução dos processos administrativos do Centro de Serviços.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Acompanhar o forecast da unidade de negócios, analisando os números previstos para identificar desvios e mitigar riscos de faturamento;
  • Gerenciar o backlog de serviços, garantindo visibilidade dos novos processos bookados semanalmente e acompanhando as demandas de compra de materiais associadas;
  • Verificar se as notas fiscais estão sendo faturadas conforme o planejamento definido no forecast dos serviços executados no mês;
  • Controlar e evidenciar todos os processos de garantia registrados no Oracle relacionados ao Centro de Serviços, assegurando rastreabilidade e conformidade;
  • Coordenar e executar os processos administrativos da área de Serviços, garantindo aderência às políticas e procedimentos internos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar informações operacionais e financeiras por meio de dashboards e relatórios (ex.: Power BI), suportando decisões da liderança;
  • Gerenciar PRs e POs relacionadas aos processos do Centro de Serviços, assegurando prazos, conformidade e alinhamento financeiro;
  • Coordenar os processos de faturamento de serviços e materiais, garantindo acuracidade e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Gerenciar processos de refaturamento, atuando na análise de causa raiz e na correção definitiva;
  • Realizar e supervisionar movimentações de materiais no estoque, garantindo registros corretos e rastreabilidade nos sistemas;
  • Coordenar e participar de inventários físicos e cíclicos, assegurando acuracidade de estoque e compliance;
  • Apoiar o planejamento dos serviços internos e externos, atuando em conjunto com os Coordenadores de Serviços para alinhamento de prazos, recursos e demandas;
  • Manter contato direto e recorrente com os Coordenadores de Serviços para alinhamento operacional e administrativo;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar o S&OP da area de serviços;
  • Garantir a correta documentação administrativa, financeira e de estoque dos processos;
  • Atuar como referência técnico-administrativa para analistas júnior e pleno, oferecendo suporte e orientação;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, garantindo atendimento aos requisitos;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas como Finanças, Supply Chain, Planejamento, Qualidade e EHS;
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, padronização e otimização dos processos administrativos.

Quem você é:

Você é um(a) profissional organizado(a), analítico(a) e orientado(a) a resultados, com forte senso de responsabilidade e visão sistêmica. Atua com autonomia, proatividade e clareza na comunicação, sendo referência técnica para a equipe e parceiro(a) da liderança e dos coordenadores na condução dos processos administrativos e operacionais.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Finanças, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento de materiais e de serviços, com atuação em ambientes operacionais e de serviços;
  • Conhecimento e vivência em processos de produção, incluindo fluxo de materiais, controle de prazos e integração com áreas operacionais;
  • Experiência em rotinas administrativas, financeiras, faturamento, forecast, backlog e controle de materiais, preferencialmente em áreas de Serviços ou ambientes industriais;
  • Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em ferramentas do pacote Office;
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado;
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente Oracle;
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba, SP.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Financial Operations Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join the Credix Finance team. The mission of this role is to ensure the operational backbone of our Capital Markets structure runs without errors. You will be responsible for the daily execution of critical tasks - specifically the "plumbing" of our credit operations (CERC registration, document signing) and treasury flows (disbursements and reconciliations).

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Finance, or a related field.
  • Operational Process: Familiarity with back-office routines (payments, reconciliations, file management).
  • Data: Strong ability to organize data, use SQL and Excel, and maintain error-free spreadsheets.
  • Basic Financial Concepts: Understanding of what a receivable is, basic debits/credits, and bank reconciliation.
  • Platform Savvy: Comfort learning new software quickly (e.g., CERC portals, banking platforms, internal admin tools).
  • Extreme Attention to Detail: The ability to spot a 1-cent difference in a reconciliation or a typo in a document contract.
  • Process-Oriented: Enjoys following checklists and finding ways to make repetitive tasks more efficient.
  • Communication: Not afraid to "raise the hand" and escalate issues immediately when something doesn't look right.
  • Ownership: Treats every payment and document as if it were their own money/company.
  • Curiosity: Eager to learn how the financial machine works "under the hood."

Responsibilities

  • Execute the smooth assignment of credit rights to the SEC/FIDC, utilizing internal tooling, CERC, and document signing processes.
  • Manage and monitor all lifecycle events including repurchases, cancellations, and transfers between SEC and FIDC with zero operational errors.
  • Establish and maintain strong daily operational relationships with stakeholders to facilitate mutual support.
  • Evaluate and recommend financial tools to improve efficiency and accuracy, as well as explore new tools that might better suit our evolving needs.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Lead developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced understanding development using JavaScript frameworks.
  • Advanced English
  • Experience with Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Nice to have, develop frontend framework for other teams
  • Develop frontend web applications in NodeJS and React
  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)

title: DevOps/Platform Lead(Cloudflare-first)—Reliability + IT Ops(Light Helpdesk) — E-commerce
description:
DevOps / Platform Lead (Cloudflare-first) — Reliability + IT Ops (Light Helpdesk) — E-commerce

  Campinas, SP (base) | Hybrid (Brazil — 3 days/week in-office in Campinas-SP)

⏳  CLT | Full-time

✅  Easy Apply (LinkedIn) |   Resume required (PDF)

About firmly

firmly solutions turn moments of product discovery (AI, social, content, ads, messaging, etc.) into instant purchases through its agentic commerce platform — with fast, embedded checkout and a strong focus on security and reliability.

The role

We’re looking for a  highly accomplished DevOps / Platform Lead to own reliability, delivery, and platform foundations for mission-critical commerce and checkout systems in a  Cloudflare-first (edge/serverless) environment. You’ll set the standard for how we build, ship, observe, secure, and operate production systems—enabling teams to move fast with confidence.

You’ll also own  Corporate IT operations , including  light helpdesk (user setups, access, device configuration), while prioritizing automation and self-service to keep support scalable (approx. 70% Platform/Reliability, 30% IT Ops ).

This is a hybrid role with 3 days per week in-office in Campinas-SP.

What you’ll do (Platform / DevOps / Reliability)

  • Own and evolve our  Cloudflare-first platform , including  Workers and related services (e.g.,  KV, Durable Objects, Queues, R2, D1 — as applicable).
  • Lead our  Infrastructure as Code practice – owning the approach, tooling, and standards (tool-agnostic), with strong reviewability, repeatability, and secure-by-default controls.
  • Own  Cloudflare tooling and automation ( Wrangler , CI/CD integration, environment management, secrets, rollouts).
  • Build and continuously improve  CI/CD pipelines , release processes, and deployment safety (staged rollouts, canary/blue-green patterns where applicable, fast rollback).
  • Drive  observability (logs/metrics/tracing), define and operationalize  SLOs/SLIs , improve alerting quality, and raise on-call readiness (“you build it, you run it”).
  • Lead incident practices: triage, comms,  blameless postmortems , and prevention plans that measurably reduce repeat incidents.
  • Strengthen security posture across systems:  least privilege , secrets management, secure configuration, and secure-by-default standards.
  • Improve performance and resilience across edge/serverless systems: latency, caching strategy, rate limiting, backoff/retries, graceful degradation.
  • Own operational standards: runbooks, reliability reviews, and DR/backup strategy (as applicable to the architecture).

What you’ll do (Corporate IT, IT Operations & Light Helpdesk — scoped)

  • Own  identity & access for corporate tools (SSO/MFA, access reviews, joiner/mover/leaver processes; least privilege).
  • Provide  light helpdesk support for user setup and common requests (accounts, permissions, device setup, basic troubleshooting), with a focus on  fast resolution and clear escalation .
  • Manage  onboarding/offboarding end-to-end (laptops, accounts, tool access, checklists) and keep documentation current.
  • Administer core  SaaS tools and coordinate vendor support when needed.
  • Own lightweight  IT Operations : request intake/triage, SLAs, ticket hygiene, and reducing repeat issues through automation.
  • Maintain baseline  endpoint and security hygiene (patching expectations, MDM/endpoint controls if applicable, secure configs).
  • Support  network access operations where applicable (VPN/Zero Trust policies, access rules, Wi-Fi office setup).
  • Maintain  asset and license inventory , and streamline procurement/renewals (devices, peripherals, licenses).
  • Reduce support load by building  self-serve resources and automation (templates, scripts, runbooks, tools, onboarding flows).

What we’re looking for

  • Strong experience with DevOps/SRE/Platform Engineering, including leading initiatives and mentoring engineers.
  • Proven track record operating  production systems with strong uptime, latency, and security requirements.
  • Strong experience with  Infrastructure as Code and Git-based workflows (code reviews, modules, multi-environment setups).
  • Strong experience with  CI/CD and safe delivery practices (quality gates, staged deploys, fast rollback).
  • Strong  observability and incident management skills (logs/metrics/tracing, SLOs, alert tuning, postmortems).
  • Strong security fundamentals (authN/authZ, secrets management, least privilege, secure-by-default design).
  • Experience running production workloads on Cloudflare—especially Workers—is strongly preferred; equivalent serverless/edge experience is also welcome, with willingness to ramp up quickly on Cloudflare.
  • Comfort owning  Corporate IT/IT Ops in a lean environment, including light helpdesk, with a strong bias toward automation and scalable processes.
  • Excellent communication and leadership—able to influence engineering habits and architecture across teams.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) — you’ll collaborate with a global team in English.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model: 3 days/week in our Campinas-SP office.

Bonus points

  • Experience with  e-commerce , checkout, payments, fraud/risk, or other mission-critical transaction systems.
  • Cloudflare security/performance:  WAF, DDoS, bot management, rate limiting, caching/CDN strategy .
  • Event-driven architectures, async processing, queues/streams (including edge patterns).
  • Experience implementing  SSO/IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD) and endpoint management/MDM practices.
  • Internal developer platform / developer experience (golden paths, templates, paved roads, self-service tooling).
  • Cost optimization mindset (FinOps) for serverless/edge workloads.

Benefits & growth

  • Unimed Nacional health plan (coverage for spouse/partner and children)
  • Meal and food allowance (VR/VA)
  • Life insurance
  • UniOdonto dental plan
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities (mentorship, ownership, room to grow with the team)
  • Clear growth path (regular feedback and performance cycles)
  • Ownership & autonomy (high-impact work, end-to-end responsibility)
  • Learning & development support

How to apply

Click Easy Apply on LinkedIn and attach your resume (PDF).

Tip: parts of the interview process may be conducted in English.

description:
The ideal candidate is a strong motivated expert with deep knowledge of the Brazilian automotive distribution sector, strong business development capabilities, and negotiation skills. also Able to face rejection and challenges when pioneering a new market.

Responsibilities

1. Network Development and Planning

Conduct in-depth analysis of the Brazilian automotive market landscape, consumer preferences, and competitor network layouts.

Develop a sales network development blueprint (city selection, network density, partner profile) aligned with our brand positioning and market objectives.

2. Potential Partner Development and Screening

Proactively identify, screen, and build a database of potential dealership investors.

Target high-quality partners through various channels including industry connections, exhibitions, associations, and commercial data.

3. Business Negotiation and Contract Signing

Lead all business negotiations with potential dealers, clearly communicating our brand value, product planning, commercial policies, and support systems.

Prepare investment proposals, contract documents, and finalize the signing of dealer authorization agreements.

4. Store Setup Support and Acceptance

Guide and support newly contracted dealers in completing store construction or renovation according to BAIC's global CI/VI standards and local Brazilian requirements.

Coordinate internal resources to provide support to dealers in areas such as team building, system installation (DMS), and initial inventory preparation.

5. Dealer Relationship Management and Performance Support

Serve as the primary interface between dealers and the company, building and maintaining solid, mutually trusting cooperative relationships.

Assist new dealers in launching operations and continuously monitor their sales, marketing, and after-sales performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields
  • Proficient in Portuguese and English , capable of using them as working languages for professional negotiations and written communication (Chinese is a significant plus).
  • At least 5 years of work experience in the Brazilian automotive industry , of which 3+ years must be focused on automotive dealership network development, dealership management, or large B2B sales management .
  • Possess an established network of Brazilian automotive dealership investors and industry connections .
  • Possess excellent business negotiation, financial analysis, and contract management skills.
  • Outstanding presentation skills and interpersonal skills, able to represent the brand and communicate effectively with senior business professionals.
  • Able to travel frequently, covering Brazil's core cities.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Audio Producer II
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Audio Producer II with a background in audio production workflows. This role involves cross-functional collaboration, and managing external partnerships to deliver exceptional audio experiences. This role will provide hands-on support in voice-over production tasks, music editing, and operational processes , ensuring smooth workflows between the audio team, internal, and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in voice-over production tasks, including communicating with vendors and internal local teams.
  • Communicate with internal and external partners to identify audio needs, plan execution, and ensure alignment from pre-production to delivery, acting as a key point of contact for audio-related matters.
  • Participate in the development of music, sound effects, and voice-over production schedules, ensuring alignment with multidisciplinary planning and vendor timelines.
  • Create comprehensive briefings for audio outsourcing partners, providing all necessary creative, technical, and production information.
  • Create, edit, and implement sound effects, voice-over assets, and other audio deliverables.
  • Mix audio content for publishing videos.
  • Ensure all audio deliverables meet project requirements, maintaining the highest quality standards across multiple projects.

Main job requirements:

  • Superior degree completed;
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in audio post-production workflow.
  • Expertise in audio editing tools such as Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in English and Portuguese (written and spoken), with experience collaborating with internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with experience designing schedules and estimating budgets for complex projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving challenges.
  • Knowledge of middleware tools like Wwise or FMOD is a plus.
  • Passion for games or a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations;
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

- Please, make sure to share in your CV or Linkedin, the link of your portfolio/IMDB/Demo reel.

- Exclusivity contract required.

title: Sr Demand Planning and Product Analyst
description:
The Sr Demand Planning & Product Analyst support the demand forecasting process for the respective business channels to generate a perspective on unit demand. He/she facilitates discussions with business stakeholders by channel to reconcile unit level forecasts against financial targets, key initiatives and productivity. The Demand Planning & Product Analyst oversees that POs are placed in accordance with forecasting alignment with each channel, in a timely fashion to ensure adequate inventory levels (launch and sustain).

The mains responsibility will be to ensure optimal level of stocks using analytical, marketing, and sales data to avoid ruptures and depreciation.

Overall

  • Facilitates monthly forecast/planning meetings with business areas, discussing current trends and risks/opportunities.
  • Educates business areas on demand forecasting processes and requirements, ensuring alignment between Demand Plan and Financial Forecast- identifying gaps and generating solutions to reconcile them.
  • Implements best practices for the planning function and partners with channels to ensure the best and necessary data to analyze and drive the business
  • Participate in major go-to-market milestones to gain insight to key seasonal strategies and initiatives.
  • Aligns OTB processes by channel to meet sales, margin, and inventory turn targets, Rolling Demand Plan and markdown plans. Ensures POs and Transfer orders are places accordingly.
  • Support in-market stock position assuring the right volumes are available on DTCs business and Retail doors.
  • Communicates delivery constraints, operational issues/opportunities. Flags irreconcilable issues to manager for problem solving and escalation as needed.
  • Drives the development and roll-out of tools to support demand planning efforts and data collection defining and establishing “best in class” planning processes and driving strategic and continuous improvement activities
  • Provides quarterly & seasonal historical data analysis & insight as inputs for future planning
  • Leads demand planning monthly reporting, developing and monitoring KPIs to track forecasting accuracy and other key metrics (inventory aging and obsolescence).

DEMAND PLANNING

  • Use analytical, marketing, and sales data to effectively estimate future product demands.
  • Duties include planning inventory flow, analyzing statistical data, and generating forecasting solutions.

IMPORTATION

  • Support Marketing Manager to build and control importation orders including promotional items
  • Follow-up shipments and guide commercial teams on ruptures/overstock
  • Control and manage depreciation

KPIS

  • Understand brand’s metrics and improve DOI KPI
  • Keep track of brand’s fill rate

MARKET ANALYSIS

  • Support Marketing Manager gather and analyze constant information on the Market evolution, trends and competitors
  • Price Analysis and Price Tables Updates

COMMERCIAL SUPPORT

  • Develop monthly launch books to facilitate commercial presentation and negotiation with Retailers
  • Touchpoint to Commercial team: send launch products and keep “order form” updated
  • Prepare Special Sales support material

BUDGETS

  • Support on Marketing Manager on building/revising sales forecast

Key Competencies

  • Functional Work Knowledge (Demand Planning, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Full Abilities

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets

Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options

Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts

Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems

Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams . If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior BI Consultant
description:
Organizational Description:

About Cambay Solutions: Cambay is a Microsoft Partner IT firm delivering the Microsoft Three Cloud Strategy; Microsoft 365, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure by providing Managed Delivery, Infrastructure, Engineering & Workforce global High-Performance services around the Microsoft stack to provide innovative transformative customer experience programs to achieve business outcomes, goals & objectives!

At Cambay Solutions LLC, everything we do, every day adds fuel to exceptional digital customer experience. We do this by utilizing our technology expertise to enable our clients to deliver an exceptional experience to their customers.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior BI Consultant who can transform raw data into meaningful insights and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. • Lead end-to-end BI engagements including requirement gathering, data modeling, dashboard design, and deployment

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field

• Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of relational and dimensional data modeling (Star/Snowflake)

• Experience working with data warehouses and cloud platforms (Azure Synapse, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools and data integration concepts

• Strong understanding of KPI design, metrics frameworks, and reporting best practices

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work with senior stakeholders

Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de dashboards e relatórios no Power BI (DAX, Power Query, modelagem de dados).

  • Experiência em Power Automate para criação de fluxos automatizados.

  • Comprometimento em entregar soluções inovadoras que agreguem valor para a organização.

  • Apresentação de portfólio de projetos já desenvolvidos em Power BI, Power Apps e Power Automate, demonstrando experiência prática.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:

O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).

  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.

  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Descrição da Vaga:

O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.

  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.

  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.

  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Técnico de Qualidade
description:
A Cumbuca Boa é uma foodtech brasileira com crescimento exponencial e o propósito de entrar na casa das pessoas com uma comida gostosa, saudável e muito prática.

Sobre a Cumbuca Boa

A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a fast-food por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?

Para nós da Cumbuca Boa, 7 minutos é tempo de sobra para preparar refeições saborosas e saudáveis! A Cumbuca Boa nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade, e que ao mesmo tempo atenda os desafios da vida moderna.

A empresa tem como propósito revitalizar a imagem da comida instantânea, proporcionando refeições ultra rápidas e com a qualidade de comida feita em casa.

Nossa missão é encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Por que trabalhar na Cumbuca Boa?

Na nossa Cumbuca, os principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.

Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe qualidade. Procuramos fazer as coisas bem-feitas

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe diversidade. Nossa cultura é inclusiva

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe cooperação. Cultivamos um ambiente onde todos constroem juntos.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição. Não temos limite para crescer

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabem todos os sonhos do mundo.

Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!

Encontre uma empresa jovem, com um ambiente aberto, dinâmico e sempre orientado à satisfação de nossos clientes. Estamos em uma fase de crescimento e expansão, com um modelo testado e aprovado por milhares de clientes!

Para potencializar o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência em operações de produção industrial de alimentação ou refeições.

O profissional será o responsável principal por apoiar na implementação e manutenção dos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar em todas as etapas dos processos de produção, armazenamento e distribuição de alimentos, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação sanitária e das normas internas da empresa.

  • Realizar auditorias internas e acompanhar planos de ação corretiva e preventiva (CAPA);

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**

Who we are:

Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Graphic Designer with strong video editing capabilities and a solid, well-rounded portfolio. The ideal candidate has a keen eye for design, strong visual storytelling skills, and the ability to create engaging static and motion content that aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives. This role requires someone who can work independently, manage multiple creative projects, and deliver high-quality outputs consistently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling graphic designs for digital and marketing assets (social media, websites, ads, presentations, and branding materials)
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos for marketing, social media, and promotional use
  • Develop motion graphics, basic animations, and video transitions as needed
  • Ensure brand consistency across all visual and video assets
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and internal teams to translate concepts into creative outputs
  • Manage multiple design projects while meeting deadlines and quality standards
  • Review and refine designs and videos based on feedback and performance goals

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Graphic Designer with a strong portfolio showcasing both design and video work
  • Solid video editing skills, including transitions, basic motion graphics, and storytelling
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro; After Effects is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently in a remote or fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to incorporate feedback effectively
  • Experience creating content for social media, digital ads, or marketing campaigns
  • Knowledge of motion graphics or animation tools
  • Familiarity with brand guidelines and marketing performance metrics

Portfolio Requirement

  • A solid portfolio is required , showcasing graphic design work and video editing samples (including transitions and motion elements)

Benefits :

Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).

title: Gerente de PLD

title: Analista Administrativo de Pessoal - PCD
description:
Na nossa empresa, acreditamos no poder das pessoas e no impacto que um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, humano e colaborativo pode gerar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Administração de Pessoal (PCD) comprometido(a) em promover eficiência, cuidado e excelência nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal, contribuindo diretamente para o bem-estar e a jornada dos nossos colaboradores.

Somos uma organização que prioriza o respeito, a transparência e o desenvolvimento contínuo.   • Modelo de trabalho estruturado favorecendo equilíbrio e bem-estar;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo;
  • Cultura que valoriza autonomia, responsabilidade e respeito às singularidades.

Suas responsabilidades

Como Analista de Administração de Pessoal, você será peça fundamental na entrega de uma experiência impecável para nossos colaboradores. Suas atividades incluem:

  • Processamento completo da folha de pagamento e encargos sociais;

  • Gestão de férias, 13º salário e demais obrigações legais;
  • Elaboração de relatórios, indicadores e análises para apoio à tomada de decisão;
  • Atendimento e orientação a colaboradores sobre legislação e procedimentos internos;
  • Garantia de conformidade com normas trabalhistas e previdenciárias;
  • Suporte a clientes internos e externos em dúvidas e demandas da área.

Procuramos profissionais detalhistas, éticos e comprometidos com a excelência operacional, com:

  • Experiência prévia nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de legislação trabalhista e previdenciária;
  • Domínio de sistemas de folha de pagamento e controle de ponto;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Vontade de aprender, contribuir e fazer a diferença.

Nosso compromisso com a inclusão

Valorizamos a pluralidade de pessoas, histórias e perspectivas. Esta oportunidade é destinada a profissionais PCD , reforçando nosso compromisso em promover um ambiente acolhedor, acessível e repleto de possibilidades para todos.

Se você deseja atuar em um time que respeita, desenvolve e reconhece seus talentos, envie sua candidatura. Venha construir o futuro com a gente — seu próximo passo começa aqui.

title: Vendedor Interno Junior - Toxicologia
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

O Vendedor Interno fica responsável por realizar atendimento aos leads gerados (futuros clientes), via telefone e pelos demais canais de comunicação utilizados no Grupo, interagindo e negociando com os futuros clientes de baixa e média complexidade de forma personalizada, visando a conversão e a satisfação dos mesmos, bem como, o atingimento das metas do negócio.

Principais atividades:

• Fazer contato telefônico ou pelos canais de atendimento da Toxicologia de vendas diretas, oferecendo serviços e esclarecendo dúvidas conforme a necessidade dos clientes.

• Realizar negociações personalizadas com os futuros clientes (lead's qualificados), conforme as premissas estabelecidas e as necessidades do cliente e do negócio.

• Manter atualizado o registro de todas as atividades realizadas com o cliente no sistema Comercial, retroalimentando com informações a respeito do cliente e sobre as interações com o mesmo.

• Apoiar os clientes na resolução de problemas ou dúvidas antes ou após a venda, mantendo o relacionamento e realizando interface com as áreas internas do Grupo.

• Otimizar as estratégias de atendimento por adaptar e manter-se atualizado quanto ao mercado, aos serviços oferecidos e aos clientes e carteira.

• Acompanhar as metas de vendas, por meio de indicadores e alinhamento com as lideranças.

• Participar no treinamento de novos colaborares, por meio do repasse das atividades e uso dos sistemas.

• Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e manutenção dos procedimentos da área, mediante a elaboração e revisão dos documentos.

• Atuar no treinamento dos usuários dos serviços da Toxicologia, por meio da apresentação e capitação dos clientes.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

• Ensino Superior em curso (desejável Biomedicina, saúde, tecnologia);

• Desejável experiência na área de vendas;

• Pacote Office Básico;

• Conhecimento de estratégias de negociação e vendas;

• Conhecimento básico em gestão da qualidade e software CRM;

• Boa fluência verbal e escrita.

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido.

Local: Rua: Joao Pedro Cardoso, nº 158, Campo Belo- SP.

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 as 17:00 segunda a sexta-feira.

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.

Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.

Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

description:
